items.title: UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years
items.summary: ﻿The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September, according to official figures.

items.title: Judges consider submissions in bid for private prosecution of former footballer
items.summary: A panel of judges are considering a bid to privately prosecute former Scotland striker David Goodwillie and hope to issue a ruling "as soon as practicable".

items.title: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
items.summary: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.

items.title: Poundland secures extended deadline for possible rescue
items.summary: Crisis-hit Poundland has secured an extended deadline for a potential rescue amid political pressure for a solvent sale of the chain.

items.title: Activist Daniel Thomas admits criminal damage after slashing migrant dinghy in Channel
items.summary: Activist Danny Tommo pleads guilty to criminal damage at Portsmouth Crown Court.

items.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six, health ministry says
items.summary: An Israeli airstrike on a Palestinian hospital has killed at least six and wounded 28, Gaza's Health Ministry said.
